Register a profile and create its empty state directory

Usage: larp cc profile add --provider <PROVIDER> <NAME>

Arguments:
  <NAME>  Profile name: 1-32 characters from a-z, 0-9, '-', '_', starting with a letter

Options:
      --provider <PROVIDER>  Provider this profile is for [possible values: claude, codex]
  -h, --help                 Print help
